items.title: Phone-first Chains
items.body: New bottom bar: Home · Courses · Play · Friends · Leagues. Go Throw is the front door. The season league lives under Leagues (2026 champion: Kyle).

items.title: Course pages, maps & territory
items.body: Every course has a page: overview map, facts, ratings, player notes. Hole cards with satellite view. Kings of the course: most rounds, course record, birdie king, steadiest.

items.title: Trophy case: 62 badges
items.body: Bronze → Platinum ladders (Turkey, Lone wolf, Birdie machine…), a Hall of Shame, and a featured badge you can wear next to your name.

items.title: Friends, messages & UDisc import
items.body: Find people by username, text/email invites, direct messages, and import your UDisc scorecard history so your stats count all of it.
